# CartGenerator 0.5.6 macOS Maintenance Release
Release date: 2026-10-08 Platform: macOS arm64 Distribution: ad-hoc-signed direct-download DMG (not notarized)
## Artifact
- `releases/CartGenerator-0.5.6-macOS-arm64.dmg` - Size: 257 MB - SHA-256: `11e22caecd94770bf97afa37dab6a0579ee623d7d8e946f73b46f3e486857ba3`
## Main changes
- Fixed hidden native compatibility controls appearing as separate macOS windows over the Web UI. - Added a clear Step 2 route back to the previous results, and enabled `この内容で再試行` only after the request content has actually changed. - Reworked retry preparation to start with a new empty cart session instead of rapidly deleting cart rows one by one. - Added explicit pending feedback while pause or stop waits for the current item to finish safely. - Simplified successful, partial-quantity, and sold-out result messages. - Improved part-thumbnail loading, unavailable-state display, search precision, and local rendering behavior. - Replaced the macOS application icon with the approved CartGenerator artwork.
## Verification performed
- The complete Python and Cloudflare Worker test suites are run by the release build. - Python compilation, Git diff validation, application signing, DMG verification, Sparkle signing, release metadata, and packaged-resource checks are run by the release build. - The real cart-session reset is intentionally not executed during automated testing because it would abandon a live cart. Perform one controlled live retry before public distribution.
## Installation
Use Help -> Check for Updates in an earlier CartGenerator version, or install the DMG over the previous version.
## Source archive
- `releases/CartGenerator-0.5.6-source.tar.gz` - SHA-256: `ade5305d5b3d85cb2d46a4cf2a26cce89018bd5c8d12df987f7364ba6a067022`
## Automatic updates
After publication, the signed Sparkle feed will offer 0.5.6 to earlier installations.
